title: Tag pills — which looks level on your screen?

steps.path: Every tag pill — session list, Session details, Resume, chat cards
steps.headline: These are the real pills on your own screen. In which pane do the word and the tag icon look level?
steps.notice: Look at "work" first — that's the one that looked off. The old icon is back exactly as before; the word and icon are now drawn as one line, and every pill keeps its size. Only the icon moves between panes, one pixel each way.
steps.risk: A one-pixel move can't suit every word; pick the pane that looks right for most.

variants.label: Word 1 px higher
variants.summary: The word sits a pixel higher against the icon.

variants.label: Word 1 px lower
variants.summary: The word sits a pixel lower against the icon.
